The show started at 11:00 and wrapped up at 3:00. There were prizes almost every single question! The entire restaurant enjoyed ramping up for the Super Bowl, by starting off the big football game with Colorado’s BEST Disc Jockeys: JAMMIN’ DJs!

Mirage Sports Bar- Littleton, Colorado

Thank you to the Mirage Sports Bar for their hospitality and friendly staff. JAMMIN’ TRIVIA followed today’s Super Bowl 45 game! Lots of tired fans out there were still willing to put it all on the line for Colorado’s premier DJ service there to rock the house and send them home wanting more. There were only a few teams left after the big game, but they played to win. Congratulations to Team Vonnie who secured their first place victory over Team Riders On The Storm! Boston’s Gourmet Pizza- Parker, Colorado

I know that Boston’s is a client, but I’m not even kidding… I love their food. I sometimes have dreams about being in a tub full of their chicken wings. Anyway, I couldn’t think of a better atmosphere to spend the Super Bowl. The crowd was split and words were exchanged but in the end everyone just wanted to hang out and watch the game. JAMMIN’ DJs contributed JAMMIN’ Bingo to the event and I can’t believe how well it went over. I was worried people would think it was a distraction, but it turned into a bar-wide game that had literally every single person fervently watching every play for a chance at a bingo. Special thanks to Selena for making everything happen!

Team Don’t Know Jack apparently know something after taking their first victory and that $25.00 gift card. I still have a hard time believing they only missed ONE question! Unbelievable! I challenge anybody in the area to take on the new top tier nerds next week from 8:00pm-10:00pm. Thanks again to all 11 teams that showed up!

01/19/11

C.B. & Potts- Denver Tech Center, Colorado

The Denver Tech Center C.B. & Potts is always a fun time for JAMMIN’ DJs Colorado. The staff is always friendly and the crowd that faithfully shows up every week makes having fun easy. It was a grueling match with stiff area rivals Team Blank and Team Zombies Can Eat Me butting heads, but in the end Team Zombies Can Eat Me came out on top! I know Team Blank is eager for a grudge match next week! Thanks to all 14 teams that showed up to make for a great night of JAMMIN’ Trivia. To those of you who attended, remember it’s “Revved up like a DEUCE, another runner in the night.” Join us next week from 8:00pm to 10:00pm!

The faithful patrons of the Denver Tech Center C.B. & Potts.

Prizes every Wednesday evening- 1st place: $35.00, 2nd place: $10.00, & 3rd place: Free pitcher

First place for the evening was Team Zombies Can Eat Me (middle) with Team Mind Eraser (left) photobombing. Great job guys! See you next week!

Be sure to join us next Wednesday at C.B. & Potts if your in the Denver Tech Center area!

Applebees- Broomfield, Colorado

The Broomfield Applebees is JAMMIN’ DJ’s brand new location and we couldn’t be happier with the way things are turning out! The staff is friendly and their 2 for 1 specials on Tuesdays make it a great place to hang out if your in the area. Every single team is new and they are all competing to be the best nerds in Broomfield, Colorado. This week, JAMMIN’ DJs awarded Team Average Joes third place, Team My Dixie Weekend second place, and Team Vinny first place. It was an action packed night and we can’t wait to see this location grow. Thanks to all of our teams that showed up and we look forward to seeing you all in the future!

title: John Murray
excerpt: JAMMIN’ DJs, Inc. has become one of the most recognized and requested entertainment services in Colorado. John has performed at numerous events such as the NBA All Star Game, The Denver Bronco’s VIP Tail Gate Parties, The Bud Light Party Cruise, Corporate Awards Ceremonies, The Auburn University Arena Opening, Sports Commission Events, and Numerous Other…
content:
JAMMIN’ DJs, Inc. has become one of the most recognized and requested entertainment services in Colorado.

John has performed at numerous events such as the NBA All Star Game, The Denver Bronco’s VIP Tail Gate Parties, The Bud Light Party Cruise, Corporate Awards Ceremonies, The Auburn University Arena Opening, Sports Commission Events, and Numerous Other High Profile Events.

John has also been in the entertainment industry since the age of 16 and has worked with multiple disc jockey companies, night clubs, radio stations, sports teams, and even a television station.

John is also currently Entertaining people across the world as a PA (Sports) Announcer for the World Famous Harlem Globetrotters! John is also currently announcing some sports for the Colorado Buffaloes during his off time with the Harlem Globetrotters.

Some of John’s Previous Emcee and announcing events include:

The Olympic Trials,
The USA Boxing National Championship,
The Churchill Cup (Rugby),
Colorado State University and more!
Live Music Concerts
And More

He uses his entertainment diversity to expand his business and provide his clients with premier entertainment.
